subject: [PATCH v3 02/12] mm/khugepaged: count collapses where khugepaged makes them

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the improvement and applied his Acked-by tag to the patch.

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the khugepaged functionality in the Linux kernel by addressing several issues related to page collapsing and counting. The first patch, specifically, focuses on fixing a bug where the khugepaged_pages_collapsed counter was being incremented unnecessarily when the daemon is involved in the collapse process.
